1.0 Fire Prevention Measures

1.1 HOUSEKEEPING:

☐ Combustible materials stored properly

☐ Aisles and exits clear and unobstructed

☐ Trash and waste removed daily

☐ Flammable liquids in approved containers

☐ Smoking prohibited in designated areas only

☐ Hot work permits required for welding/cutting

1.2 ELECTRICAL SAFETY:

☐ Electrical panels accessible (36" clearance)

☐ No overloaded circuits or extension cords

☐ All electrical equipment properly grounded

☐ GFCI protection in wet locations

☐ Regular electrical inspections performed

☐ Arc flash hazard assessment completed

3.0 Emergency Evacuation Plan

3.1 EVACUATION PROCEDURES:

STEP 1: R.A.C.E.

- RESCUE anyone in immediate danger

- ALARM: Activate nearest fire alarm pull station

- CONFINE: Close doors and windows to contain fire

- EXTINGUISH or EVACUATE

STEP 2: Evacuation

- Proceed to nearest exit using primary evacuation route

- Do not use elevators

- Assist persons with disabilities

- Proceed to assembly point

STEP 3: Accountability

- Report to assembly point supervisor

- Account for all personnel

- Report missing persons to Incident Commander

- Do not re-enter until "All Clear" announced
